title: O Primeiro Teste de Verdade
summary: Monday 2027-02-01. Three private Fearless Draft MD3 scrims against full 2027 rosters: Main beat Dignitas 2-1, Academy Blue lose 1-2 to Blue Otter, Academy White beat the University of Mississippi 2-1. Results stay internal. Adrian considers having White keep playing NACL and possibly EMEA Masters opponents but creates no automatic NACL slot.
keyEvents: 8:47 — Emily, the four head coaches and Adrian confirm the three MD3 series; Fearless Draft means champions used in earlier games of the series cannot be picked again by either team.

9:21–12:26 — Main vs Dignitas (Denathor, KryRa, Palafox, ScaryJerry, Breezy): Dignitas win game 1 (32 min); Kairos win game 2 (30 min) with Rumble, Poppy, Galio, Varus, Rell; Kairos win game 3 (44 min) with Sion, Ivern, Taliyah, Sivir, Taric. Main 2-1.
9:43–13:31 — Academy Blue vs Blue Otter (Dcoy, Niles, Retrozing, Hub, Tubs): Blue win game 1 (27 min); Blue Otter win games 2 and 3 (game 3 at 31 min). Blue Otter 2-1.

10:12–13:47 — Academy White vs University of Mississippi (Fiji, Munchy, Perry, Sushee, Aeon Crystal): White win game 1 (31 min), lose game 2 (29 min), win game 3 (Gragas, Ivern, Taliyah, Varus, Rell). White 2-1.
16:22 — Joint review; Adrian orders that no one publish that Kairos beat Dignitas or Mississippi; results stay internal and change no ranking.

18:14 — Adrian examines White's result: he will not invent a NACL slot (eight participants, Kairos already has its representative) but wants White to keep facing NACL teams and possibly EMEA Masters opponents.
consequences: Academy White become the first Kairos development roster to beat a 2027 NACL roster in a full series (private).
Main learn they can win with off-pool champions and without relying on comfort picks.
canonIntroduced: Three private League scrims are played on 2027-02-01 (see data/matches).
Fearless Draft is used in all three series.
continuityNotes: The LCS debut is on 2027-02-15 (fourteen days after this episode).
Kairos Academy White still has no automatic place in a professional league.
realWorldReferences: Dignitas, Blue Otter and the University of Mississippi are real-world organisations; the rosters named are those already in the fictional-canon 2027 overlays.

sourceReferences.locator: Episódio 121 — O Primeiro Teste de Verdade

confirmedFacts: Main 2-1 Dignitas; Blue 1-2 Blue Otter; White 2-1 University of Mississippi. All private scrims, affects no standings.
Dignitas are projected internally as a mid-table LCS team; Blue Otter is considered an accessible NACL opponent.
unconfirmedDetails: Any official place for Academy White and the timing of further external scrims.
